en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, form his father, from Al Washa, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Muhammad Bin Qays, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineenasws judged that the Jew, and the Christian would be whipped regarding the wine and Al-Nabeez the intoxicant (drink), eighty lashes, when they display drinking it in a city from the cities of the Muslims. And similar to that is the Magian; and they would not be treated harshly when they drink it in their houses and their churches, until they come to be in between the Muslims’.
